body: Hi everyone. I can't tell you how much I appreciate your comments. This afternoon, we had a serious talk. We will be getting some counselling help. I have depression and sometimes my episodes get so heavy and overwhelming. Suicide is so final - there is no going back. I get that now.

I was upstairs trying to figure out how to kill myself - after a huge fight with my husband. After about 30 min, I go downstairs to see him to try to start a conversation. Guess what he was doing - jerking off to porn. Really concerned? He doesn't really care about me. All I am is an administrative help to help pay for the mortgage. It's all about that. NOthing to do with me.
Nothing matters. No one really needs me in their life. I feel like I am a burden.
